# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| 1.x     | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately via GitHub Security Advisories.

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/geeknik/mempool-partyline/security) on GitHub
2. Click "Report a vulnerability"
3. Provide details about the issue and steps to reproduce

Do not disclose vulnerabilities publicly until they have been reviewed and patched by the maintainers.

## Disclosure Timeline

- **Initial response**: Within 72 hours
- **Status updates**: Weekly until resolved
- **Public disclosure**: After a fix is released and users have had reasonable time to update
